issue.title: Deadlock Assertion failure at Python/lock.c:128: PyLockStatus _PyMutex_LockTimed(PyMutex *, PyTime_t, _PyLockFlags): `Assertion '_Py_atomic_load_uint8_relaxed(&m->_bits) & _Py_LOCKED' failed`

labels.name: type-crash
labels.description: A hard crash of the interpreter, possibly with a core dump

comments.body:
Reproduced on both normal and free-threading builds. 

cc @colesbury

We should only check the assertion if `_PY_LOCK_PYTHONLOCK` is *not* set on the flags.

Normally, if you lock a `PyMutex`, you don't expect some other thread to release the lock from underneath you, but we allow that behavior with `thread.Lock`.
